title: He Asked AI To Make Money. It Did.
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest offers a coupon code for his paid AI co-founder club at the end

stated_problem.quote: A lot of people are super scared of open claw because they don't want it on their local machine.
stated_problem.speaker: Robbie

idea.name: AI co-founder club: hosted personal AI agent subscription
idea.one_liner: Cloud-hosted, containerised OpenClaw agents for non-technical people plus Discord community and templates at $29/mo, validated with $10 TikTok pre-order deposits
idea.customer: non-technical consumers wanting their own AI agent
idea.offer: sandboxed 24/7 AI agent, Discord community, templates and setup

key_quotes.quote: And so I hooked up stand to my TikTok and the only way that you could pre-order was if you put down 10 bucks.
So to get around that risk, what we did was essentially put open claw inside of a sealed container.
Somebody recently spawned 125 sub agents in 5 days.

claims.claim: 617 pre-orders in two weeks from organic TikTok
claims.quote: So yeah, we did that and I put it on TikTok and said, "Hey, if you want to run, come sign up." And in two weeks, we had like 617 pre-orders.
From those 600 people, 270 of them actually join the community.
Yeah, I can tell you what it is, right? And it's 8374 right now.
The big cost that we have right now is about two grand a month for inference.

acquisition_channels.details: build-in-public 'AI starting a business' videos; 1M+ views; Apify-scraped comment demand

ideas.delivery: Docker containers on rented Contabo bare-metal servers; access via Telegram, Discord or web UI
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to hosting user data in agents

idea.name: AI-generated SWOT/market analysis gigs on Fiverr
idea.one_liner: AI agent writes SWOT and market research for small businesses sold as Fiverr gigs; failed for a new account with no reviews

key_quotes.quote: And that's why it failed because uh the hopefully they see your posting is uh kind of where it fell apart.

claims.claim: Demand exists on Fiverr for regular research
claims.quote: I was kind of amazed people that just need regular research done which kind of I think cementss the fact that most businesses don't have a good grasp of what AI is doing

acquisition_channels.details: new account, no ads or reviews

idea.name: $9 AI TikTok account audits

key_quotes.quote: He wants to audit your Tik Tok for $9 in order to stay alive.
